title: Almond Crumble Monsoon Muffins
description: Moist monsoon-inspired muffins with a crunchy almond crumble topping, perfect for a snack or dessert. These muffins capture the essence of the Mediterranean with the crunch of almonds.
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a 12-cup muffin tin with cupcake liners.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together Monsoon, crumble, sugar, and salt.
3. In a separate bowl, whisk together olive oil, eggs, and vanilla extract.
4. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
6. Divide batter evenly among muffin cups.
7. Top each muffin with a spoonful of crumble mixture.
8. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of a muffin comes out clean.
9. Allow muffins to cool in tin for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
